name: Red Hill Rail Trail
address: Red Hill Rail Trail, Merricks North VIC 3926
signature: A 6.5km trail along a disused railway corridor through Red Hill hinterland — flat, easy, and ideal for walking or cycling through winery country
editorNote:
The Red Hill Rail Trail follows the corridor of the old Red Hill railway branch line — a 6.5km flat, sealed trail that runs through the heart of the Red Hill hinterland between Merricks North and Red Hill South. It is the easiest walking and cycling trail on the Peninsula: flat, wide, well-maintained, and surrounded by the vines and orchards of the plateau.

The trail passes through classic Red Hill country — vineyards on both sides, the hinterland quiet, and enough shade to make a summer morning walk genuinely pleasant. It is also genuinely dog-friendly, which makes it one of the most popular weekend morning walks for locals.

Combine with a cellar door visit at either end — the trail drops you within easy reach of several Red Hill producers. Cyclists can ride the full 6.5km in under 30 minutes; walkers allow 1.5–2 hours return.
whyWeGo: Winery country on foot — the flattest, most accessible walk through the heart of Red Hill.
ifOnlyOneThing: Walk or ride the full 6.5km and stop at a cellar door at one end for a glass before you turn around.
